descripcion:
Cleveland-Cliffs Burns Harbor, as a receipt. Item one: Cleveland-Cliffs' 2022 annual report (Form 10-K) says it returned $240 million to shareholders through share repurchases. A share repurchase, or buyback, is when a company buys its own stock.

Item two: in February 2022 the EPA announced a consent decree (a court-approved settlement) under which Cleveland-Cliffs Burns Harbor, the company's Indiana steel mill unit, agreed to pay a $3 million penalty. It resolves alleged Clean Water Act violations over an August 2019 wastewater discharge from the Burns Harbor mill.

The total: the penalty is 1.25% of the buybacks (our math).

Sources: Cleveland-Cliffs Form 10-K for 2022; EPA enforcement page and consent decree, Feb 14, 2022.
